_comment: Every FFXI graphics setting at its maximum. The 30 fps target is only meaningful at max
settings -- the game is from 2002 and should not need anything turned down to run well.
The stock config is close but not actually maxed: background resolution ships at 2048
(4096 is the top), sound channels at the lowest 12, and mip mapping unset.
Values decoded from the [ffxi.registry] documentation in the Ashita ini.
